# StorageShare

Mobile storage sharing app built with Python and Kivy.

Share storage between Android devices securely with 4-digit pairing codes.

## Features
- "Love Pakistan" splash screen
- Wi-Fi device discovery
- 4-digit pairing code security
- Configurable storage quota
- Remote folder creation
- File upload/download
- Internet relay mode

## Build
Push to GitHub → Actions → Build StorageShare APK → Download
